GeneInput.description: An input classified before source resolution; aliases remain free text.

NciBiomarkerUse.description: NCI's native biomarker eligibility criterion, without clinical interpretation.

NcitId.description: A native NCI Thesaurus concept code.

PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

SponsorRole.description: Sponsor roles a sponsor name may match.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

TrialSource.description: Independent trial providers; results are never folded or used as fallbacks.

enum: Temporarily Closed to Accrual and Intervention

nci: Temporarily Closed to Accrual and Intervention

description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov or keyed NCI with native counts. NCI --facility matches exact organization names; a listed site is not necessarily enrolling.

acronym.description:
Acronym.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: search the registry acronym field.

age.description:
Age in years.
ClinicalTrials.gov only; unstated source bounds count as no limit.

arms_for.description:
Arms.
ClinicalTrials.gov only. Exact intervention name or alias, ignoring case.

biomarker_code.description:
NCIt code.
NCI only: exact biomarker in trial criteria such as C96022 (CD274 Gene, PD-L1). Does not establish positivity or eligibility.

biomarker_use.description:
NCI criterion; help search trial
NCI criterion.
Filter by NCI's native inclusion or exclusion criterion. Check each result's biomarker entry and reported problems.

condition.description:
Disease; NCI needs NCIt.
Conditions joined with OR. NCI needs NCIt codes such as C3224 (melanoma); use --condition-id for MONDO or DOID identifiers.

condition_id.description:
Condition ID.
MyDisease resolves exact MONDO or DOID CURIEs. NCI also takes codes such as NCIT:C3224 (melanoma).

count_only.description:
Total.
Source total only; no returned study rows.

country.description:
Country label; help search trial
Country label.
Exact ClinicalTrials.gov country label; repeat for OR. Trials must list a site in a named country. NCI uses its native country filter.

criteria.description:
Criteria text.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: search registry eligibility text with other variant spellings; no eligibility judgment.

distance.description:
Radius.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: supply units (mi or km).

exact_condition.description:
Exact condition.
Ask ClinicalTrials.gov to restrict matching to the registered condition phrase; its support is partial.

exact_term.description:
Exact terms.
Search typed drug names and variant text as written, without other names or spellings.

facility.description:
Facility.
Facility phrase; ClinicalTrials.gov broadens after zero exact matches. NCI matches exact names. Cannot combine with radius.

gene.description:
Gene symbol/ID.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: resolve one checked gene for registry text discovery; no eligibility judgment.

has_results.description:
Posted results.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: require posted source results. Each row carries has_results.

id.description:
NCT ID.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: exact ID, combined with other filters.

intervention.description:
Intervention.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: repeat to join alternatives with OR.

keyword.description:
Text; OR.
Repeat for ClinicalTrials.gov general text alternatives joined with OR; different filters combine with AND. NCI accepts one keyword.

lat.description:
Latitude.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: radius center latitude in degrees.

limit.description:
Page size.
Headers per page; NCI applies its own lower publisher limit.

lon.description:
Longitude.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: radius center longitude in degrees.

next_page.description:
Page token.
ClinicalTrials.gov: follow the returned token, selectors and offset unchanged; unbound tokens need a fresh first page.

official_title.description:
Official title text.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: search the registry official title field.

offset.description:
Rows to skip.
Zero-based first row. ClinicalTrials.gov reaches at most 5000 by offset, reading the live registry each time; --next-page goes deeper and keeps pages consistent.

phase.description:
Native phase; help search trial
Native phase.
ClinicalTrials.gov: 1–4, early-1, not-applicable, 1/2, 2/3 or PHASE3-style labels. 1–3 include combined phases. NCI: NA, 0, I, I_II, II, II_III, III, IV.

query.description:
Trial text.
ClinicalTrials.gov general text. Total counts its matches. Use --acronym or --official-title to search those fields.

sex.description:
Sex; help search trial
Sex.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: registry sex facet.

site_count.description:
Site count.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: instead of rows, the --limit facilities in the most matched trials, read over every page; names counted as registered, never merged.

source.description:
clinicaltrials/nci; help search trial
clinicaltrials/nci.
Explicit provider; defaults to ClinicalTrials.gov and never falls back.

sponsor.description:
Sponsor.
ClinicalTrials.gov only. Lead name by default. Zero hits broaden. Rare lead matches may suggest a spelling.

sponsor_role.description:
Sponsor role; help search trial
Sponsor role.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: lead (default) or any, which adds collaborators; needs --sponsor.

sponsor_type.description:
Funding class; help search trial
Funding class.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: registry sponsor funding category; use --sponsor for a sponsor name.

status.description:
Native status; help search trial
Native status.
Exact source status. NCI: Active, Administratively Complete, Approved, Closed to Accrual, Closed to Accrual and Intervention, Complete, INACTIVE, Enrolling by Invitation, Temporarily Closed to Accrual, Temporarily Closed to Accrual and Intervention, Withdrawn. ClinicalTrials.gov uses registry labels.

study_type.description:
Study type; help search trial
Study type.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: exact registry study type.

updated_since.description:
First date.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: first included registry update date.

updated_until.description:
Last date.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: last included registry update date.

variant.description:
Variant text.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: general text or criteria, with other spellings, and the codon with --gene; no eligibility judgment.

why_stopped.description:
Stop words.
ClinicalTrials.gov only: keep trials whose registry stop reason contains every word. Each row carries why_stopped.

title: TrialSearch
